scope: A parentless Parent declares a public untyped property with a sole backed block &get. Its immediate Child plainly redeclares the same public untyped property, initialized to 11 or implicitly null, with no own hook, trait, interface or constructor effect. Direct CV/literal Child fetches, own writes and a defined-RHS destination bind are covered.

target.environment: LC_ALL=C; TZ=UTC; serial exclusive CPU; 100000 model steps and 75-second source timeout

authority: Zend/zend_inheritance.c::do_inherit_property and inherit_property_hook install the plain Child's physical slot while duplicating Parent's getter.
Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_read_property invokes that getter on a Child receiver and returns its by-reference result.
Zend/zend_execute.c::zend_assign_to_property_reference fetches Get before rejecting destination rebinding.
spec/semantics/138-property-references.watsup attaches no OBJECT_PROP_SOURCE when the selected Child descriptor has no type.
